--------
CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMBUJ NATH  --------

For the Petitioner : Mr. Vikash Kumar, Advocate For the State : Mr. Rajesh Kumar, A.P.P For the Opp. Party No.2 : Mr. Rohit Agarwal, Advocate --------
04/ Dated 12.06.2024 Heard the parties.

The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Rajnagar P.S. Case No. 67 of 2021, for the offences under Sections 498A/323/313 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3 / 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, pending in the Court of learned C.J.M., Seraikella.
Petitioner is the husband of the informant.
Their marriage was solemnized in the year 2012.
It appears that after the marriage, there was demand of dowry and to enforce the demand, opposite party No.2 was driven away from her matrimonial home.
It was submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the opposite party No.2 has not sustained any injury at the hands of the petitioner.
It was further submitted that the present case has been instituted after nine years of marriage between the parties.
Learned counsel for the opposite party No.2 has opposed the prayer for bail and he has very fairly submitted that the opposite party No.2 has not sustained any injury at the hands of the petitioner.

He is directed to surrender before the court below within two weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order and the learned court below on his surrender shall release him on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/-(Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned C.J.M., Seraikella, in connection with Rajnagar P.S. Case No. 67 of 2021, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438 (2) Cr.P.C.
BS/ (Ambuj Nath, J.)
